humanoid.doc: Baked Mecanim humanoid clips. clips['<clip key>|<Rig>'] has ordinary bone tracks (same shape as the generic clips) for the Avatar of rig <Rig>; track paths are relative to the rig node = the child of the Player/enemy object that has mixamorig:Hips below it (T-Pose (N), PlayerMesh). Horizontal root motion is removed (see 'travel', rig-node units per second, three axes); vertical bob stays. 'aliases' maps a short name (the clip name, or name.<pathId> when two clips share a name) to the generic clip key; 'owners' maps a scene object (Player1.., enemy, enemy (1)..) to the baked rig key to use.
